title: A worker whose touches name a kb/_self doc runs the _self lookup eval before it reports, so a reword that costs a tested row a pack note is found before the landing
goal: The brief of an item whose touches name a kb/_self doc tells its worker to run the _self lookup eval through a command its permission rules allow (rag.py eval --root _self, or a backlog.py wrapper) and report its noted count against NOTED_BASELINE, so a doc reword that pushes a tested row's answer words out of the pack excerpt is fixed on the worker's branch, not found at land's eval step

run:
import sys, tempfile, json, subprocess, os
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_base, bl_dispatch
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True)
bl_base.load_settings(d)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir()), exist_ok=True)
item = {"id": "ST-aaaaaaaa", "kind": "story", "title": "reword a doc", "status": "doing", "priority": "P3", "rank": 0, "goal": "the section is reworded", "checks": [{"run": ["true"]}], "touches": ["kb/_self/backlog.md"]}
open(os.path.join(d, bl_base.rel_dir(), "ST-aaaaaaaa.json"), "w").write(json.dumps(item))
bl = bl_base.Backlog(d)
bl_dispatch.rules_section = lambda bl, iid: ["x"]
t = bl_dispatch.compose_brief(bl, "ST-aaaaaaaa")
ok = "rag.py eval --root _self" in t and "NOTED_BASELINE" in t
print("brief of a _self doc item runs the _self eval:", ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
